answer: Reaching the fable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the lantern until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round.
